{"id":2041667490,"question_id":4340,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month","timestamp":1782105765,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"7 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2041667490/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Manhattan Distance After All Moves","memory":"22.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maxDistance(string moves) {\n        int hori = 0;\n        int verti = 0;\n        int underscores = 0;\n\n        for(auto move : moves)\n        {\n            if(move == 'U') verti++;\n            else if(move == 'R') hori++;\n            else if(move == 'D') verti--;\n            else if(move == 'L') hori--;\n            else underscores++;\n        }\n        return abs(hori) + abs(verti) + underscores;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-manhattan-distance-after-all-moves","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2202}
